```yaml
name: Pull Request Beyla Integration Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  generate-integration-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run script to generate integration test matrix
        id: set-matrix
        run: |
          WEIGHTS_FILE=${{ github.event.pull_request.number != null ? '${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.path }}/internal/test/integration/custom_weights.json' : '${{ github.event.repository.path }}/internal/test/integration/default_weights.json' }}
          ./internal/test/integration/generate-integration-matrix.sh --weights-file $WEIGHTS_FILE > matrix.json
          echo "::set-output name=matrix::$(cat matrix.json)"

  run-integration-tests:
    needs: generate-integration-matrix
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{fromJson(needs.generate-integration-matrix.outputs.matrix)}}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: go test -v internal/test/integration/${{ matrix.test }}

  free-up-disk-space:
    if: always()
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Free up disk space
        run: sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
```

    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.set-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository

      - name: Run script to generate integration test matrix

          echo "::set-output name=matrix::$(cat matrix.json)"

  run-integration-tests:
    needs: generate-integration-matrix
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{fromJson(needs.generate-integration-matrix.outputs.matrix)}}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
